@mother_parent rule
  when mother ?x ?y
  then parent ?x ?y

@father_parent rule
  when father ?x ?y
  then parent ?x ?y

@grandparent_rule rule
  when parent ?x ?y
  when parent ?y ?z
  then grandparent ?x ?z

@grandmother_rule rule

  when parent ?y ?z
  then grandmother ?x ?z

@ancestor_base rule

@find_ancestors template
  description "Găsește strămoșii unei persoane prin regulile aprobate."
  cue "ascendență"
  cue "strămoși"
  params person
  yield answer
  body |
    @q query
      mode select
      select ?who
      where ancestor ?who $person
    @m recall
      query $q
    @r reason
      query $q
      memory $m
    @answer cnl
      result $r
      language ro

@check_arrival template
  description "Recuperează durata rutei și calculează sosirea într-o zi, în minute de la miezul nopții."
  cue "sosire"
  cue "ajung"
  params route start deadline
  yield answer
  body |
    @travel query
      select ?duration
      where duration $route ?duration
    @retrieve_duration solve
      query $travel
      output ?duration one
    @timing constraint
      var ?arrival int 0 1440
      require ?arrival == $start + $duration
      claim ?arrival <= $deadline
      task possible
      unit minute
    @feasibility solve
      constraint $timing
      output ?arrival one
    @answer cnl
      result $feasibility
      language ro

@mother_parent rule
  when mother ?x ?y
  then parent ?x ?y

@father_parent rule

  then parent ?x ?y

@grandparent_rule rule
  when parent ?x ?y
  when parent ?y ?z

@find_ancestors template
  description "Găsește strămoșii unei persoane prin regulile aprobate."
  cue "ascendență"
  cue "strămoși"
  params person
  yield answer
  body |
    @q query
      mode select
      select ?who
      where ancestor ?who $person
    @m recall
      query $q
    @r reason
      query $q
      memory $m
    @answer cnl
      result $r
      language ro

@check_arrival template
  description "Recuperează durata rutei și calculează sosirea într-o zi, în minute de la miezul nopții."
  cue "sosire"
  cue "ajung"
  params route start deadline
  yield answer
  body |
    @travel query
      select ?duration
      where duration $route ?duration
    @retrieve_duration solve
      query $travel
      output ?duration one
    @timing constraint
      var ?arrival int 0 1440
      require ?arrival == $start + $duration
      claim ?arrival <= $deadline
      task possible
      unit minute
    @feasibility solve
      constraint $timing
      output ?arrival one
    @answer cnl
      result $feasibility
      language ro

  body |
    @q query
      mode select
      select ?who
      where ancestor ?who $person
    @m recall
      query $q
    @r reason
      query $q
      memory $m
    @answer cnl
      result $r
      language ro

@check_arrival template
  description "Recuperează durata rutei și calculează sosirea într-o zi, în minute de la miezul nopții."
  cue "sosire"
  cue "ajung"
  params route start deadline
  yield answer
  body |
    @travel query
      select ?duration
      where duration $route ?duration
    @retrieve_duration solve
      query $travel
      output ?duration one
    @timing constraint
      var ?arrival int 0 1440
      require ?arrival == $start + $duration
      claim ?arrival <= $deadline
      task possible
      unit minute
    @feasibility solve
      constraint $timing
      output ?arrival one
    @answer cnl
      result $feasibility
      language ro
